name: companion
description: Companion — self-hostable Skills Hub for organizations and coding agents.
readmeExcerpt:
# Companion

Companion is a self-hostable Skills Hub for organizations and external coding agents.
Create, validate, version, organize, share, install, and publish portable `SKILL.md` packages.

Personal skills are creator-only; organization skills are shared with every member. Labels organize
libraries without changing access. The web app and CLI provide the same Skills Hub workflows,
including dependencies, comments, immutable public releases, GitHub mirrors, write-only secrets,
and declared tenant-scoped SQLite Skill Databases. External agents connect through delegated Agent Auth.

## Repository

- `apps/web`: Next.js interface.
- `apps/api`: REST/tRPC authorization and Skills Hub APIs.
- `apps/worker`: GitHub sync, billing, and Skill Database object cleanup.
- `cli`: Companion CLI.
- `packages`: shared contracts, domain services, auth, database, packages, storage, and bundled skill.

See [vision](docs/vision.md), [product](docs/product.md), [architecture](docs/design.md),
[requirements](docs/PRD.md), and [testing](docs/testing.md).

## Local development

Requirements: Node.js 20.19+ or 22.12+, pnpm 9, PostgreSQL 17, and optionally MinIO/Mailpit.

```bash
corepack enable
pnpm install
pnpm dev:conductor
```

Conductor starts per-workspace PostgreSQL, optional MinIO/Mailpit, API, worker, and web. It configures
isolated cookies and ports, applies migrations, and seeds the local test user. `.env.example`
documents optional integrations. `pnpm dev` provides the Docker-backed development stack.

## Deployment

Build with `pnpm build`. Run the migration owner entrypoint before starting API, worker, and web
from that build. `pnpm db:migrate` preserves historical migration compatibility, including the
legacy role variables required to replay earlier releases; these do not launch a runtime service.
Use separate NOBYPASSRLS credentials for API and worker. See [Railway deployment](deploy/railway/README.md).

Hosted Companions are retired. Existing installations must clean up external resources using the
previous release before applying the retirement migration; see [retirement](docs/companions-runtime.md).

## Verification

Run `pnpm verify:change` and complete its printed follow-up gates. Frontend changes also require
`APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> pnpm browser:smoke` and manual browser checks.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A web and mobile UI for deploying and managing secure fleets of task-optimized AI agents with persistent memory.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Companion provides a unified graphical interface for orchestrating fleets of specialized AI agents built on Claude Code and Codex. It abstracts the complexity of deploying isolated AI environments by allowing users to launch agents with specific roles, tools, and private network access directly from a browser or mobile device. The system integrates 'Granite' vaults for durable memory, enabling agents to maintain context over time and share specific memories with other agents in the fleet. It also facilitates secure, private access to agent APIs and dashboards via Tailscale, ensuring sensitive workflows remain protected from the public internet.
keyFeatures: Fleet Orchestration: Deploy and manage multiple specialized agents (e.g., researcher, coder, analyst) from a single dashboard.
Granite Memory Vaults: Provides agents with durable, persistent memory that can be selectively shared across the fleet.
Private Network Access: Integrates with Tailscale to expose agent APIs and UIs securely without public internet exposure.
Isolated Environments: Runs each agent in its own isolated runtime to prevent cross-contamination of tools and data.
Client-Ready Workspaces: Allows rapid duplication and deployment of standardized agent fleets for different clients or projects.

useCases.title: Multi-Agent Workflows
useCases.description: Coordinate a team of specialized agents where one handles research while another writes code based on shared memory.

useCases.title: Secure Client Deployments
useCases.description: Quickly spin up an isolated, secure AI workspace for a client without needing to manually configure the underlying infrastructure.

useCases.title: Mobile Agent Management
useCases.description: Monitor agent tasks, approve tool usage, and interact with your AI fleet while away from your desktop.

useCases.title: Private Enterprise Operations
useCases.description: Run powerful AI workflows on sensitive internal data safely hidden behind a Tailscale VPN.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: AI engineers, operations teams, and consultants who need to manage multiple, specialized AI agents securely. It is ideal for users looking to scale agentic workflows beyond a single local terminal.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Clone the repository and follow the setup instructions to configure your Tailscale network and Granite vaults.
